BETA Close X Bellway PLC has executed its share buyback program, purchasing a total of 151,598 ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange between September 7th and September 11th, 2026. The volume-weighted average price for these purchases was 2,033.65 pence per share, with the highest price paid at 2,100.00 pence and the lowest at 1,968.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 112,196,214. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 14 September 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 14 September 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 1 September 2026, from 7 September 2026 up to and including 11 September 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the 'Ordinary Shares') through Citigroup Global Markets Limited. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 7 Sep 2026 29,000 2,100.00 2,076.00 2,088.64 XLON 8 Sep 2026 29,000 2,082.00 2,042.00 2,062.51 XLON 9 Sep 2026 29,000 2,052.00 2,018.00 2,032.93 XLON 10 Sep 2026 29,993 2,030.00 1,989.00 2,007.01 XLON 11 Sep 2026 34,605 2,002.00 1,968.00 1,987.07 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Buyback Programme on 1 September 2026, Bellway has purchased 265,091 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 112,196,214 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Citigroup Global Markets Limited on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
